conflict_flags.rationale: SOW Supplement A directly states the Task Order Construction Budget as $800,000. The RFP uses the phrase 'Estimated Construction Price Design Magnitude' which is a VA category/band (a design magnitude range indicator) rather than a precise budget figure. The $870,000 figure in the RFP may reflect a slightly different estimate timeframe or may include design contingency. SOW is the more operationally precise figure.

conflict_flags.rationale: 512A5-18-302 is an earlier (2018) project number associated with an initial design phase / change order. The 2020 design contract (SOW) was issued as a new NRM project 512A5-20-302. Both numbers refer to design work for the same physical fuel tank replacement, but 512A5-20-302 is the primary contract governing the A/E services documented in the SOW.
